boards.title: Your First Weekend at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented on campus and making a daytime visit downtown.

cards.title: Start with the self-guided campus route
cards.subtitle: Daytime orientation · RPI campus
cards.notes: Open the location-enabled tour on your phone and follow its mapped walking route to learn the campus layout before choosing indoor stops.
cards.short_summary: A mapped introduction to 21 RPI locations.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI's self-guided tour includes a location-enabled map, a route to 21 campus locations, and walking paths between stops.
cards.access_notes: The university notes that most buildings may not be open to the public depending on date and time; follow pedestrian and traffic laws.

cards.title: Use the Union as your campus anchor
cards.subtitle: Sage Avenue and 15th Street · RPI campus
cards.notes: Pause in the Union to locate meeting rooms, student services, dining, and social spaces; check its event listings for an appropriate program.
cards.short_summary: A central building for study, events, dining, and student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rensselaer Student Union contains meeting rooms, businesses, dining, and social spaces, and is a place to study or attend special events.
cards.access_notes: Access and individual activities can vary; check the Union's current event information before attending.

cards.title: Set up a first study stop at Folsom
cards.subtitle: 110 8th Street · RPI campus
cards.notes: Find a seat, connect your device, and note the service desk before the week begins; bring your RPI ID for regular building access.
cards.short_summary: RPI's main library, with study space and campus Wi-Fi.
cards.evidence_claim: Folsom Library is at 110 8th Street, and RPI-affiliated patrons can use Wi-Fi there; the library publishes current hours online.
cards.access_notes: Current hours are seasonal. An RPI ID opens Folsom's front doors; visitors without one must request entry using the exterior intercom.

cards.entity_name: Curtis R. Priem Experimental Media and Performing Arts Center (EMPAC)
cards.title: See EMPAC’s common spaces
cards.subtitle: 50 8th Street · RPI campus
cards.notes: Visit during posted weekday building hours, then look for a future talk, tour, exhibition, or work-in-progress event that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A campus arts center with public common spaces and programming.
cards.evidence_claim: EMPAC welcomes people to study and gather in its level 5 and 6 common spaces, and says its talks, tours, and work-in-progress events are free and open to all.
cards.access_notes: Common spaces are listed as Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM. Confirm event availability and registration requirements before going.

cards.title: Locate the RPI Playhouse for later programs
cards.subtitle: RPI campus · performance-space stop
cards.notes: Walk by the Playhouse and save the Union events page; return for a listed performance rather than assuming a show is scheduled that weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Rensselaer Union manages performance spaces in the RPI Playhouse.
cards.access_notes: Attend only a currently posted event; entry terms and accessibility details depend on the individual program.

cards.title: Find the Mueller Center recreation facilities
cards.subtitle: RPI campus · campus recreation stop
cards.notes: Walk over to identify the facility and review current campus-recreation information before planning a workout or wellness activity during the term.
cards.short_summary: A Union-managed location for fitness, weight training, and wellness programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Rensselaer Union manages fitness and weight-training facilities and wellness programs at the Mueller Center.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and programming are managed by campus recreation; verify current eligibility, hours, and reservation requirements.

cards.title: Get your bearings at Houston Field House
cards.subtitle: 1900 Peoples Drive · RPI campus
cards.notes: Find the Field House and check the athletics calendar for a current, under-21-safe game or campus event before committing to a visit.
cards.short_summary: RPI's historic sports arena and a campus shuttle destination.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI's archives state that Houston Field House was acquired for use as a sports arena and was dedicated in 1949.
cards.source_title: Houston Field House | Institute Archives and Special Collections
cards.access_notes: The Rensselaer Shuttle identifies a Houston Field House stop at 1900 Peoples Drive. Event admission and access vary.

cards.title: Take a shuttle loop to connect the campus
cards.subtitle: Student Union is the route start and stop
cards.notes: Use the campus shuttle to practice reaching housing and athletic-area stops, allowing extra time because service times are approximate.
cards.short_summary: A free-with-ID campus route linking the Union, housing, and athletic stops.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI states that students can ride Rensselaer Shuttles for free with their campus ID and publishes weekend operating hours and route stops.
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 service is listed Saturday 9 AM–midnight and Sunday 9 AM–8 PM; times may vary with traffic and weather.

cards.title: Spend Saturday morning at the Troy Waterfront Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: Monument Square / River Street · downtown Troy
cards.notes: Browse the market without pressure to buy, then use the official market map to identify vendors and find your way around downtown.
cards.short_summary: A year-round Saturday market in downtown Troy with seasonal locations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Troy Waterfront Farmers Market states that it operates every Saturday from 9 AM to 2 PM, outdoors around Monument Square from May through October and at Troy Atrium from November through April.
cards.access_notes: Verify the seasonal location before travel. The market lists Saturday hours as 9 AM–2 PM.

cards.title: Finish with a Hudson River park walk
cards.subtitle: 255 Front Street · downtown Troy
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk through the riverfront park, then connect to the nearby northern terminus of Troy’s two-way cycle track if you are biking.
cards.short_summary: A City of Troy waterfront park near downtown and the Uncle Sam Bike Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Troy identifies William D. Chamberlain Riverfront Park at 255 Front Street and lists Riverfront Park as the northern terminus of the two-way cycle track.
cards.source_title: Uncle Sam Bike Trail | Troy, NY
cards.access_notes: Use daylight and follow local park and trail rules. The City lists Riverfront Park at Front Street and River Street.
